title: DFT study of halogenated InTeX (X = Cl, Br and I) monolayers: promising 2D materials for nanoelectronics
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9578-9589
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00185H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tuan V. Vu, Dat D. Vo, Oleg Khyzhun, Michał Piasecki, Thi H. Ho, Nguyen N. Hieu
First-principles calculations were performed to investigate the structural, electronic, mechanical, and spintronic properties of InTeX (X = Cl, Br, and I) monolayers formed via full halogenation of pristine InTe.
